scripts.test:json: mkdir -p reports && cucumber-js --require-module ts-node/register --require src/support/**/*.ts --require src/steps/**/*.ts --format json:reports/cucumber-report.json
scripts.test:html: mkdir -p reports && npx cucumber-js --require-module ts-node/register --require src/support/**/*.ts --require src/steps/**/*.ts --format json:reports/cucumber-report.json; node reporter.js
